message.content:
The value of $20 in British Pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent rates (mid‑2026), 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP. Using that rate:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \text{ GBP/USD} \approx \textbf{£15.60}
\]

**Note:** Exchange rates vary constantly. For an exact, up‑to‑date conversion, you can check a reliable financial news source, a bank’s website, or a currency‑conversion app.
